prose: Mirendil announced Lor, a system it describes as doing the work of an entire AI lab: its agents write code, run experiments and iterate on results for days at a time, across any machine, hundreds of agents in parallel. Lor is now in private beta.
highlights: Mirendil's Lor: agents that write code, run experiments and iterate for days
Marketed as doing the work of an entire AI lab, hundreds of agents in parallel
Basis: Mirendil's X announcement; page extraction too thin for more
basis: The source page (an X post) yielded only the announcement text itself (extracted text under 400 chars), so this entry is based on that text and the TLDR AI feed summary.
